propositions: Jira mappings are currently hardcoded literals in value_maps.py, config.py, and inbound_fields.py, blocking axis config-driven refactoring
A provider-neutral mapping_config module must be established to define schema, merge rules, validation, and capability descriptors before individual axes (S2–S5) can be wired
The mapping section must be registered as reserved in _RESERVED_SECTIONS and read raw via read_reserved_section to bypass unknown-key warnings and coercion

Axis maps (status_map, type_map, link_map, priority_map, create_defaults) must deep-merge per key with precedence built-in ← default ← projects.<KEY>, while vocabulary declarations (statuses, issue_types, link_types, hierarchy) replace wholesale per layer

Configuration validation must fail closed offline against effective vocabulary: every axis-map value must appear in its declared vocabulary or be the skip sentinel, and malformed blocks must raise MappingConfigError

The core module must remain provider-neutral, importing no adapters.jira* modules, with capability flags (has_types, has_transitions, has_hierarchy, has_link_types, has_priorities) gating which axes are available
